messages:
Omar Haddad: Hey team — Omar here, excited to join as an ML infra engineer (remote, EST). Quick setup asks: I haven't received the MDM invite for my new Mac, and I still need org GitHub access + access to the dedicated test cluster. Also, hello icebreaker: I brew my own kombucha, I once lived in Tokyo, I hate coffee (two truths and a lie).

Jules Park: welcome Omar :tada: I'll add you to the ml-infra channel and the weekly sync. For the test cluster, @Ben can help add your cluster role.

Ben Cho: pinged you a repo invite for `ml-serving` — let me know your github handle. I can grant cluster role once IT confirms machine enrollment.

Omar Haddad: handle is omar-h. Thanks, Ben.

IT Support: Hi Omar — sorry about MDM. Could you open a ticket at help.redwood.ai and include your laptop serial and preferred shipping address? We can resend the MDM invite; also confirm if the laptop is already on-hand.

Kelsey - People Ops: Welcome! Orientation is tomorrow 11am EST (calendar invite sent). Swag and access paperwork are in progress; check your email for benefits forms.

Devex Bot: Helpful links: onboarding checklist: https://console.redwood.ai/onboarding. Dev env guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/dev-env. Run `./scripts/dev_setup.sh` after GitHub access.

Jules Park: also adding you as my buddy for the first two weeks — we can do an async runbook review Wed at 2pm EST.

Omar Haddad: laptop is arriving tomorrow — will open the ticket now. And for the icebreaker: I never lived in Tokyo (that's the lie) — I do brew kombucha and I actually dislike coffee :sweat_smile: Looking forward to the sync!

Ben Cho: added your cluster role and re-sent the GitHub invite. SSH test should say 'Hi omar-h!' once keys are set up.

IT Support: MDM invite resent to omar.haddad@redwood.ai. Reply here if you don't see it by EOD.

Omar Haddad: got the invite and the GitHub accept — SSH test passed. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
